page_title: ATM 3-1 VIL | Atletico Madrid v Villarreal 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
90' The ball goes out of play and Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.

89' The opposition back off Ramon Terrats (Villarreal), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom right corner, but Jan Oblak denies him with the save. Villarreal force their opponents to concede a corner.
88' Here comes a substitution. Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Alvaro Morata.
86' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Atl. Madrid players have a reason to celebrate!
86' Wait! Referee Francisco Maeso has indicated he is going to review the Atl. Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
85' 3 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Pablo Barrios finds Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball inside the right post. 3:1.
85' Chance! Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Angel Correa, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
84' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) will replace Alberto Moreno.
83' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Villarreal have a free kick.
80' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Marcos Llorente is the provider as he slips the ball to Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 2:1.
77' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.

76' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Filip Jorgensen was alert and the score remains the same.
74' Substitution. Alex Baena walks off the pitch and Carlos Romero (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
73' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
72' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.

71' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Free kick. Villarreal will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
70' Nahuel Molina comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid).
70' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle and it's Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick to Villarreal.
69' The game is interrupted as Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is flagged offside.
68' Villarreal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
65' The game has come to an end for Rodrigo Riquelme. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid).
65' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Rodrigo de Paul will be replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
63' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
61' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul and Francisco Maeso immediately signals a free kick. Villarreal will take a free kick near the side line.
59' The flag is raised and Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is offside again, not for the first time today.
58' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
57' Koke (Atl. Madrid) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
57' The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.

56' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Filip Jorgensen thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
56' A goal, which was scored by Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid), was disallowed due to offside.
54' Great ball in from Marcos Llorente. Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post.
54' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

53' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
52' The attendance for today's match is 56632.
51' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.

50' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jan Oblak anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Diego Simeone gives a chance to Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) and Saul Niguez is off.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Yeremy Pino cannot continue after picking up an injury.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Rodrigo de Paul plays a beautiful lofted pass to Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position.
45+2' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) is given a yellow card.
45+1' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Antoine Griezmann sprays a pass out to Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
41' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
40' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fires a low volley towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.

39' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Filip Jorgensen pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
38' The linesman raises his flag. Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
37' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
36' Alexander Sorloth has picked up an injury and is replaced by Ramon Terrats (Villarreal).
36' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
34' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
34' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
32' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle and signals a foul after Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) brought his opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Villarreal.
31' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
29' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

28' Great save! Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Jan Oblak. The linesman makes the right call and Villarreal will have a corner.
26' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

25' Koke (Atl. Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
25' Atl. Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
25' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

24' A cross from Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Atl. Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 0:1.
20' Excellent touch by Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
19' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find Alvaro Morata, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
17' A pass into the box finds Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Jan Oblak denies him.
16' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Jan Oblak and he makes a comfortable save.
16' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the corner with a short pass.

15' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
12' An accurate cross picks out Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
11' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
10' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) picks up an injury.
8' The shot by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Filip Jorgensen.
7' Wow, what an escape. Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
6' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
4' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
2' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Villarreal.
1' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
1' The first half has just begun.
Atl. Madrid will kick-off.
Francisco Maeso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
